name: chat-app-privacy
description: Ephemeral WebSocket chat rooms that self-destruct after inactivity

scripts.build: npm run build -w @chat/protocol && npm run build -w roomsbackend && npm run build -w roomfrontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @chat/protocol && npm run build -w roomsbackend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @chat/protocol && npm run build -w roomfrontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chat/protocol && npm run typecheck -w roomsbackend && npm run typecheck -w roomfrontend
